The dish is a small spinach salad with a few slices of egg or onion, on a square plate of roughly 26 cm. The salad covers about 10 by 17 cm, which is a modest serving. I estimate about 10–12 spinach leaves at roughly 60 g total, plus a few egg or onion slices at roughly 20 g. That gives about 80 g of food. Spinach is only about 23 kcal per 100 g, so the greens add around 15 kcal. Egg adds a little more, and any dressing looks minimal. I put the total at about 35 kcal.
